title: Dimensions of Bedford-McMullen type sets in $\mathbb Z^2$
summary: We study forward orbits in $\mathbb Z^2$ generated by the expanding affine maps $(x,y)\mapsto(mx+i,ny+j)$, where $m\ge n\ge2$ are integers and $(i,j)$ ranges over a nonempty digit set $Λ\subseteq\{0,\ldots,m-1\}\times\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. We obtain explicit formulae for the mass, Beurling, discrete packing, and Assouad dimensions, the discrete Hausdorff dimension and its lower variant, and the lower entropy index.
